{{< include _imports.qmd >}}

```{r notebook opts}
FORCE_REDO <- FALSE
# FORCE_REDO <- TRUE
results_filter_fnc <- function(df) {
    df %>% 
    filter(CPM.cutoff == '3CPM') %>% 
    filter(z.score.counts) %>% 
    filter(n.SVs == NUM_SVS_TO_GENERATE) %>% 
    filter(SVs.included == NUM_SVS_TO_REMOVE)
}
```

## Load Input data to generate CRDs

```{r load_sample_metadata}
# load sample metadata
all.sample.metadata <- 
    load_sample_metadata()
```

```{r load_peak_residuals}
# ATAC data
all.ATAC.and.SV.datasets.df <- 
    list_all_ATAC_datasets() %>% 
    # which sets of samples to use to call CRDs
    cross_join(RESIDUAL_MATRIX_SAMPLE_PARAMS_DF) %>% 
    # map files with estimated SVs to the corresponding residual matrices
    inner_join(
        list_all_results_files_in_set(set.name='SVs'),
        by=
            join_by(
                CPM.cutoff,
                residual.model,
                AD.definition.column,
                sample.strategy
            )
    ) %>% 
    filter(sample.strategy %in% c('All.Samples')) %>%
    select(-c(AD.definition.column, sample.strategy))
```

## Load CRD features + summary stats over OCRs per CRD

First load all different CRD-level features across all sets of estimated CRDs
```{r load_all_CRD_features}
all.CRD.features.df <- 
    check_cached_results(
        results_file=ALL_CRD_STATS_TSV_FILEPATH,
        force_redo=FORCE_REDO,
        results_fnc=
            function() {
                list_all_results_files_in_set(set.name='CRD.stats') %>% 
                results_filter_fnc() %>% 
                mutate(
                    CRD.stats=
                        future_pmap(
                            .l=list(filepath),
                            .progress=TRUE,
                            .f=read_tsv,
                            show_col_types=FALSE
                        )
                ) %>%
                unnest(CRD.stats)
            }
    ) %>% 
    select(
        CPM.cutoff, residual.model, 
        # z.score.counts, n.SVs, SVs.included,
        is.decorate.filtered,
        AD.definition.column, sample.strategy, meanClusterSize, merging.level, 
        CRDID, CRD.feature.type, CRD.feature, CRD.value
    )
```

### Count how many CRDs + total peaks there are in total

Summarize CRD-level feature to get genome-wide totals
```{r make_CRD_counts_data}
stat.vars <- 
    c(
        "CRD.length",
        "CRD.nPeaks",
        'peak.length-total'
    )
CRD.counts.df <- 
    all.CRD.features.df %>%
    filter(CRD.feature %in% stat.vars) %>% 
    select(-c(CRD.feature.type)) %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from=CRD.feature, values_from=CRD.value) %>% 
    group_by(across(-all_of(c('CRDID', stat.vars)))) %>% 
    summarize(
        .groups='drop',
        nCRDs=dplyr::n(),
        CRD.length=sum(CRD.length),
        CRD.nPeaks=sum(CRD.nPeaks),
        `peak.length-total`=sum(`peak.length-total`)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        CRD.density=1e6 * CRD.nPeaks / CRD.length,
        CRD.peak.coverage=100 * `peak.length-total` / CRD.length
    )
```

### For all merged CRDs, get features for each CRD

From the full set of features, get the OCR-level summary statistic for each OCR feature
```{r get_OCR_feature_summaries_per_CRD}
OCR.summary.stats.df <- 
    all.CRD.features.df %>% 
    filter(CRD.feature.type %in% c('CRD.stats', 'peak.summary.stats')) %>%
    separate_wider_delim(
        CRD.feature,
        delim='-',
        names=c('feature', 'summary.stat'),
        # too_few='align_end'
        too_few='align_start'
    ) %>%
    mutate(summary.stat=ifelse(is.na(summary.stat), 'Size', summary.stat)) %>% 
    # mutate(feature=ifelse(is.na(feature), 'Size', feature)) %>% 
    filter(summary.stat != 'sd')
```

### For all merged CRDs, load OCR-level summary stats of differentila stats (logFC + p.value)

From the full set of features, get the OCR-level summary statistic for the indival OCR diffferential statistics computed by Roman.
```{r get_OCR_differential_summaries_per_CRD}
all.CRD.differential.stats.df <-
    all.CRD.features.df %>% 
    filter(meanClusterSize == 'merged') %>% 
    filter(CRD.feature.type == 'peak.differential.stats') %>% 
    separate_wider_delim(
        CRD.feature,
        delim='-',
        names=c('contrast', 'metric', 'summary.stat')
    ) %>%
    filter(summary.stat != 'sd')
```

## Load all merged CRDs

```{r load_merged_CRDs}
all.merged.CRDs.df <- 
    list_all_results_files_in_set(set.name='merged.CRDs') %>% 
    results_filter_fnc() %>% 
    mutate(
        CRDs=
            future_pmap(
                .l=.,
                .f=combine_CRD_Locations_and_PeakLists,
                .progress=TRUE
            )
    ) %>% 
    unnest(CRDs) %>% 
    select(
        CPM.cutoff, residual.model, AD.definition.column,
        z.score.counts, n.SVs, SVs.included,
        sample.strategy, meanClusterSize, merging.level,
        is.decorate.filtered,
        CRDID, detected.in.groups
    )
```

## Decorate differential CRD statistics

Load differential CRD statistics
```{r load_all_differential_stats}
all.differential.CRD.results.df <- 
    check_cached_results(
        results_file=ALL_CRD_DIFFERENTIAL_STATS_TSV_FILEPATH,
        force_redo=FORCE_REDO,
        # force_redo=TRUE,
        results_fnc=
            function() {
                mutate(
                list_all_results_files_in_set(set.name='CRD.differential.stats') %>%
                    diff.stats=
                        future_pmap(
                            .l=list(filepath),
                            .f=read_tsv,
                            show_col_types=FALSE,
                            .progress=TRUE
                        )
                ) %>%
                unnest(diff.stats) %>%
                filter(nPeaks >= 5) %>% 
                # count CRDs per pre-merged origin grouping
                group_by(
                    CPM.cutoff, residual.model, CRD.sample.strategy,
                    z.score.counts, n.SVs, SVs.included,
                    meanClusterSize, is.decorate.filtered,
                    contrast, method,
                    detected.in.groups
                ) %>% 
                mutate(nCRDs=length(unique(CRDID))) %>%
                ungroup(detected.in.groups) %>% 
                mutate(
                    log10.p.value=-log10(p.value),
                    p.adjust=p.adjust(p.value, method='BH'),
                    log10.p.adjust=-log10(p.adjust)
                ) %>% 
                ungroup()
            }
    ) %>% 
    filter(
        contrast %in% 
            c(
                "sex-Male-Female",
                # "Biobank-Rush-MSBB",
                # "Braak_3levels-Braak_5plus-Braak_Max2",
                "Braak_3levels-Braak_5plus-Braak_3to4",
                "CDR_3levels-Dementia-Healthy",
                "age-NA-NA",
                "AD_CERAD_withDLB-AD-Control"
            )
    ) %>% 
    filter(!is.na(p.value)) %>% 
    select(-c(count, filepath))
```
